violation_type.title: Care Requirements for Toddlers -Same Caregiver Regularly (26 TAC §746.2501(2))
violation_type.short_title: Care Requirements for Toddlers -Same Caregiver Regularly
violation_type.typical_finding: The toddler classroom does not have the same caregiver on a consistent basis.

finding_variants.text: The toddler classroom does not have the same caregiver on a consistent basis.

Based on evidence gathered, staff did not ensure a toddler was cared for by their regular when they decided to move the toddler to another room with a different caregiver because the toddler's assigned caregiver felt uncomfortable taking care of the toddler when the toddler was sick.
